items.note: Play on a run played backward to its start now seeks to the run's end and plays backward.

items.claim: Backward replay that keyed on `ended` and always played forward
items.note: `replay` plays the way Play does and keeps the held direction. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Speed the transport held not following a redeclared clock speed
items.note: the hold takes each declared speed until a transport sets a speed. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.
`shape` now keys on the speed `declare` takes. That rule is exported from `@weasel-js/clock` as `declaredSpeed` (minor changeset).

items.claim: HeldClock's forced `rate: 0` resetting a rate-derived speed, and `sameDeclaration` skipping rate

items.note: it records against the spec the clock was opened from. The inline-literal resubscription goes with it.

items.claim: `replay` doing nothing for a clock that isn't seekable
items.note: Play and `replay` reset an ended clock that isn't seekable and play it from the start. The call is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: Keyed transport answering page keys when no trial is focused
items.note: `useFocusPick` makes `focusedTrialId` fall back to `trialIds[0]`, so in a lab with trials it is never null, and B's case of two trials with none focused can't occur.
